Our process

Five steps to a flawless finish

  1. 1

    Consultation

    We understand your goals — heat, privacy, protection or design — and recommend the ideal film.

  2. 2

    Site assessment

    We measure your glass or surfaces and confirm a clear, flat-rate quote.

  3. 3

    Preparation

    Every surface is deep-cleaned for perfect, bubble-free adhesion.

  4. 4

    Precision install

    Films are cut to fit and applied, sealed and smoothed by specialists.

  5. 5

    Final inspection

    We check clarity, edges and performance before handover.
